# Alexandre Grothendieck — Sur quelques points d'algèbre homologique (Tôhoku): French and English editions

### Authors/Creators

  * Grothendieck, Alexandre

## Description

A complete edition, visual-evidence, and semantic checkpoint for Alexandre Grothendieck's Sur quelques points d'algèbre homologique (Tôhoku Mathematical Journal 9 (1957), pp.119–221).

This version contains two independent cumulative readers for the complete printed paper: a corrected French edition and a source-aligned English edition. Each has its own PDF and cumulative LaTeX master. The English reader is the landing preview.

This successor repairs only vertical-arrow row spacing on printed pp.162, 164, 165, 186, and 205. The exact delta is 30 spacing-token replacements across 15 aligned source files. No mathematical token, wording, authority reading, or stable semantic identifier changed.

The visual archive contains individual direct-authority, French-output, and English-output crops at 5,000 dpi-equivalent for all 15 diagrams and 27 intricate mathematical blocks: 127 accepted crops and 26 preserved rejected attempts.
